headline: Datadog shares tumble despite earnings beat and stronger full-year outlook
summary: Datadog (NASDAQ:DDOG) shares plunged more than 21% in pre-market trading on Thursday, even after the cloud monitoring and cybersecurity specialist reported better-than-expected second-quarter results and lifted its full-year guidance. The sharp selloff appeared to reflect investor profit-taking following the stock’s recent record highs, rather than any deterioration in the company’s operating performance.
